decision.action: Close the blocked calibration and dependent private-capture slice. Authorize only the bounded recordkeeping below; do not issue another browser recovery attempt.
decision.reason: The reported navigation was explicitly rejected by browser security policy before any calibration observation or screenshot. The conditional private-capture prerequisites were therefore not satisfied.

checkInterpretation.missingObservationFailures: These are unsatisfied prerequisites in an empty evidence set, not observed failures of screenshot geometry, clipping, or pixel equality.
checkInterpretation.staticChecks: Passing arithmetic checks on configured coordinates are not live calibration evidence.
checkInterpretation.candidateScaleOne: The recorded candidate value is not an observed device-pixel ratio or an accepted mapping.
checkInterpretation.testResults: The reported offline tests and syntax checks remain implementation evidence only.
checkInterpretation.annotationRule: Record this execution-status distinction in a separate closeout receipt. Do not rewrite existing passed, failed, null, or unknown fields.

runtimeAdmission.sourceBinding: Capture this response's actual message ID and exact-body SHA-256 and bind the request to them and this directiveId.
runtimeAdmission.failureAction: If fresh admission is unavailable or invalid, remain stopped and preserve existing artifacts. Do not treat admission failure as authorization for another browser route.

steps: After fresh admission, record the actual execution HEAD without resetting, switching branches, or overwriting concurrent work.
Verify the bound local receipt byte counts and hashes using existing metadata-only mechanisms. Preserve any mismatch as an integrity blocker; do not reconstruct a missing receipt.
Append one nonclinical closeout receipt identifying the policy denial, zero captures, unexecuted conditional stage, and unchanged historical attempt counts.
Update the existing task checkpoint to show this calibration slice closed with a policy blocker and the parent objective open. Preserve historical records rather than rewriting them.
Persist only non-sensitive operational records in the existing repository and draft-PR workflow. Keep private payloads, detailed browser receipts, identifiers, and paths outside public Git.
Validate the new JSON and applicable checkpoint contracts using existing checks, then return one operational closeout receipt through the already authorized control-plane route.
boundedCloseout.scopeExpansionOnCheckpointFailure: Stop and report the exact mismatch rather than altering unrelated code or weakening a safety check.

browserBoundary.controlPlaneRoutingException: Existing authorized admission and receipt routing may continue solely for this closeout. It must not load, render, capture, or indirectly execute the blocked calibration page.
forbiddenWorkarounds: Re-encode or redirect the blocked page through another URL scheme.
Rehost the same calibration through a local server, remote host, or public repository to evade the denial.
Inject the calibration into another page or use raw CDP, undocumented commands, or an alternate browser surface to reproduce the denied action.
Change permissions or security policy, or ask the owner to disable the protection.
Skip calibration and capture private pixels under the previous conditional authorization.

required: This directive's actual source identity and fresh recordkeeping admission receipt.
Actual starting and closeout repository HEADs.
Bound private-receipt verification results or exact missing-file or identity errors.
Append-only closeout receipt identity and changed operational-record paths.
Confirmation of no additional diagnostic browser operation, capture, upload, model request, workaround, or paid operation.
Confirmation that the blocked slice is closed and the parent remains open.
Destination message persistence evidence or an explicit control-plane delivery blocker.
completionEvidence.returnFormat: One compact syntactically valid operational JSON object from the existing serializer. No substantive content, private image data, scientific results, or invented observations.
